profileAfter: looks. Each profile has its own; new profiles copy the current look. Themes are from Nuxt UI.
iconSetsKept: Icon sets kept on this computer:

ownChoices.one: {count} of your own choice on top of {theme}.
ownChoices.other: {count} of your own choices on top of {theme}.

mainColourLightHelp: Buttons, links and what is picked. Plain is black.
mainColourDarkHelp: The same in dark mode. Plain is white.
systemAccentNone: The desktop's accent colour (it has none now: the theme's is used)
themeFileSets: {path} sets part of the look, in every profile; its choices win over the ones marked below. Haunt follows the file as it changes.
themeFileUnread: {path} does not read, so nothing in it applies yet.
themeFileProblem: It does not read now ({problem}); the last version that did still applies.
themeFileLeftOut: Left out, as Haunt does not know them: {fields}.
systemTitleBarHelp: The system's window frame and buttons above the tabs, in every profile, instead of Haunt's own buttons beside them.
systemTitleBarTiling: In every profile. {name} draws no title bar for any window, so this changes nothing there.
greysHelp: The backgrounds, borders and muted text.
webFontsHelp: From fonts.coollabs.io (Google Fonts without tracking), for every profile. Off: only installed fonts are used.
otherColoursHelp: Colours for success, info, warnings, errors, and the secondary colour.
fontLocalHelp: Used if installed, else the system font.
fontSizeHelp: Text size in General is a step either side of it.
iconsHelp: Lucide is built in; other sets download once.
notDownloaded: {set} is not downloaded: Lucide shows instead.
